sections.heading: Wind, Hail and Storm Damage
body: **Wind and hail can damage a roof long before water shows inside.** We inspect for free and repair what is damaged.
Lifted shingles, cracked shingles and dented vents are easy to miss from the ground.
When the damage calls for an insurance claim, we file it and work with your adjuster, the same way we do on a [roof replacement](/roof-replacement-wichita-ks/).

footer.about: Flawless Roofing Co is a Wichita roofing company at 928 S Broadway. We replace and repair roofs, and we also do siding, gutters and painting.
why: Free roof inspections and insurance claim help
Free class 4 upgrade, downspouts and gutter guards included
Your Google reviews describe a roofer who inspects for free, files the claim, meets the adjuster and puts a new roof on in a day, with free impact-resistant shingles. Ravi is named in 11 of them.
Your site shows none of that. The top of your homepage says "Roofing Redefined for Modern Living", with no town and no roof work named, and the "Services" item in your menu goes nowhere.
So we built a site that says roofing company in Wichita at the top, gives replacement and repair their own pages, and puts your customers' words beside their work.
strategy.cardsHeading: Be the Roofing Company People Find on Google
strategy.cardsIntro: Each card is one page: what your site does today and what we changed.

cards.title: Homepage
cards.why: The page Google reads to learn who you are and where you work.
problems: The top of the page says "Roofing Redefined for Modern Living", so Google can't tell you're a roofing company in Wichita.
Your menu's "Services" item goes nowhere, so a visitor looking for your work hits a dead end.
No customer reviews near the top, so a new visitor sees no proof.
fixes: A headline that says roofing company in Wichita, KS, right at the top.
A menu where every item opens a real page, and all eight services listed.
A customer review right under the top of the page.
cards.alsoAdd: Every page set up behind the scenes so Google and AI tools like ChatGPT know exactly what you do, where you work, and what your customers say.

cards.title: Roof Replacement
cards.why: New roofs are most of your reviews, and they share one page called "Roofing".
problems: Replacement, repair and inspection sit on one page headed only "Roofing", so Google has no page to rank for roof replacement in Wichita.
Its "Our Testimonials" heading shows no reviews under it.
fixes: Its own page for roof replacement in Wichita, KS: the claim, the free upgrade and roof day.
Four reviews, each beside the point it proves: the claim, the upgrades, a next-day roof and the cleanup.
cards.alsoAdd: Call and form tracking that shows which pages and towns your leads come from.

cards.title: Roof Repair
cards.why: A leaking roof is a call you answer fast, and repair has no page.
problems: Repair is one line on the "Roofing" page, so someone searching roof repair in Wichita finds nothing built for them.
fixes: A page for roof repair in Wichita, KS: leaks, storm damage and the free inspection.
The same-day tarp review near the top.
cards.alsoAdd: A check of what your competitors offer, so services you didn’t think to mention still get their own pages.

cards.title: Contact
cards.why: Where a ready customer reaches you.
problems: The "Start A Project" button on your contact page goes nowhere.
fixes: One tap to call at the top of the page, with your hours, address and email.
A short list of what to have ready.
cards.alsoAdd: Hourly speed monitoring that keeps your site fast for visitors on phones, and speed is something Google uses to rank you.

onboardingQuestions: Owner's full name and how he wants to be introduced: BBB lists Yagnesh Zinzuwadia, customers say Ravi.
Is ravi@flawlessroofingcousa.com the address to publish?
Manufacturer certifications (GAF, Owens Corning, CertainTeed): which, and where are you listed? None is claimed in this copy.
Kansas roofing contractor registration number, license and insurance details to show.
Free class 4 upgrade, downspouts and gutter guards: current, and any terms or limits? Does it apply to every new roof?
Is NEW ROOFS STARTS AT 99$ a real offer, and what does it cover? It is left out.
Warranty on workmanship or materials, and any financing partner: none found, so none claimed.
Years in business: BBB shows March 2023; the site shows no number.
Service area: BBB lists Butler, Harvey, Kingman, Reno, Sedgwick and Sumner Counties; the site names only Wichita. Which towns should be listed?
Derby address on BBB: is it a live office?
Does the 928 S Broadway office take walk-ins, and do the Google hours match Monday to Friday, 10 to 6?
Commercial roofing: how much of the work, and any project types to name?
Typical roof schedules, and whether the free tarp for a leak is standard or was a one-off.
The $200 referral reward: current, and may it go on the site?
How should the crew be named, and are there photos of finished Wichita roofs we can use?
A review says you are licensed in Hutchinson and Wichita areas: is Hutchinson a town to list, and is there a license to show?
The copy says "Based in Wichita" rather than "locally owned": may we say locally owned?
